newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CAIL ends Christmas Island contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CAIL ends Christmas Island contract.

text.p: Casinos Austria International Ltd (CAIL) said on Friday it had terminated the management agreement for the Christmas Island Resort Hotel and casino on the grounds of breach of the management agreement by the Resort owners.
CAIL said it would be claiming substantial damages from Christmas Island Resort Pty Ltd.
The decision to leave follows a dispute with the Resort owners headed by Indonesian businessman, Robby Sumampow, who holds a 90 percent interest in the resort.
CALL said it had a five year management agreement and a five year option with Christmas Island Resort commencing in 1993.
CAIL, which is controlled by Casinos Austria AG, said it had offered to continue as operator of the hotel and casino for a handover period to ensure a smooth handover of the operation.

It said it had had no financial involvement in the Christmas Island casino, and that no revenues were attributed to the re-adjusted revenue and profit forecasts which, developed in conjunction with Price Waterhouse at the end of 1996, indicate a return to profitability for the company for the 1997 year.
Casinos Austria shares closed one cent down at 27.5 cents.
